{{External|rs|rsc|dw=Amulet of Accuracy}} {{Infobox Item |name = Amulet of accuracy |image = [[File:Amulet of accuracy.png]] |release = [[16 February]] [[2001]] |update = New quest, and more fixes |members = No |quest = [[Imp Catcher]] |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wear, Drop |examine = It increases my aim. |value = 100 |weight = 0.010 |exchange = Yes |id = 1478 }} [[File:Amulet of accuracy detail.png|left|130px]] An '''amulet of accuracy''' is a reward from the [[Imp Catcher]] [[quest]]. To complete [[Imp Catcher]], [[Wizard Mizgog]] trades an amulet of accuracy for a set of [[black bead|black]], [[red bead|red]], [[white bead|white]], and [[yellow bead]]s. After the quest it is possible to give him one of each bead again for another amulet. The amulet is easily obtainable for new players because the quest has no requirements apart from killing [[imp]]s; however, it is only recommended if the player is an [[Ironman Mode|Ironman]] lacking [[Magic]] levels to enchant better amulets. [[Amulet of power]] is already a straight upgrade across all stats. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = +4 |aslash = +4 |acrush = +4 |amagic = +4 |arange = +4 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = 0 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = neck |image = [[File:Amulet of accuracy equipped male.png|130px]] |altimage = [[File:Amulet of accuracy equipped female.png|130px]] }} ==Creation== {{Recipe |notes = {{SCP|quest}} Completion of [[Imp Catcher]] |members = No |ticks = 1 |facilities = Wizard Mizgog |mat1 = Black bead |mat2 = Red bead |mat3 = White bead |mat4 = Yellow bead |output1 = Amulet of accuracy }} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Amulet of accuracy}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 20 July 2017 |update = F2P_Castle_Wars |change = Players may now exchange one of each bead to obtain another amulet after completing [[Imp Catcher]]. {{Subject changes footer}} }} ==Gallery (historical)== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Amulet of accuracy detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Amulet of accuracy detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Amulet of accuracy (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Amulet of accuracy.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2
